en.headline: Observatory issues Amber Rainstorm Warning; thunderstorms until 3pm
en.dek: Heavy rain exceeding 30 mm an hour is expected to continue generally over Hong Kong after the signal was issued at 12.25pm, with the Thunderstorm Warning extended until 3pm.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 12.25pm on Monday, saying heavy rain had fallen or was expected to fall generally over Hong Kong, exceeding 30 millimetres in an hour, and was likely to continue.
The Observatory warned of flooding in some low-lying and poorly drained areas and of possible flash floods. People were advised to stay away from watercourses and to take precautions against losses.

Separately, the Thunderstorm Warning first issued at 11.30am was extended until 3pm. A few squally thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong. Members of the public outdoors were told to seek safe shelter, leave the water and keep away from high ground and conductive objects.
The remnant of Tropical Cyclone Saudel continued to influence the region, with more showers and storms forecast later in the day and into Tuesday.

zh.headline: 天文台發黃色暴雨警告 雷暴警告延至下午3時
zh.dek: 天文台下午12時25分發出黃色暴雨警告，預料廣泛地區每小時雨量超過30毫米；雷暴警告則延長至下午3時。
body: 香港天文台周一中午12時25分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，表示香港廣泛地區已錄得或預料會有每小時雨量超過30毫米的大雨，且雨勢可能持續。
天文台提醒，一些低窪地帶及排水欠佳的地區會出現水淹，大雨可能引致山洪暴發，市民應遠離河道，並採取適當預防措施避免損失。
另外，上午11時30分發出的雷暴警告已延長至下午3時，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴。市民身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿站立高地或接近導電物體。
沙德爾殘餘繼續影響本港附近，預料稍後至周二仍有較多驟雨及雷暴。
